비타스프링클Niacin · Biotin · Vitamin A · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B12 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin C · Vitamin D · Vitamin E · Folate · Pantothenic acid

Made by (주)서흥 · Once a day · 1 sachet

This product combines 10mg of Niacin, 56μg of Biotin, 211.1μg of Vitamin A, 2mg of Vitamin B1, 2.9μg of Vitamin B12, 2mg of Vitamin B2, 2mg of Vitamin B6, 30mg of Vitamin C, 5μg of Vitamin D, 8mg of Vitamin E, 126μg of Folate, 5mg of Pantothenic acid as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 sachet): 10mg Niacin, 56μg Biotin, 211.1μg Vitamin A, 2mg Vitamin B1, 2.9μg Vitamin B12, 2mg Vitamin B2, 2mg Vitamin B6, 30mg Vitamin C, 5μg Vitamin D, 8mg Vitamin E, 126μg Folate, 5mg Pantothenic acid
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by (주)서흥

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Niacin
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Biotin
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production
  • Vitamin A
    • Needed for the adaptation of vision in dim light
    • Needed to form and maintain skin and mucous membranes
    • Needed for the growth and development of epithelial cells
  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B12
    • Needed for normal folate metabolism
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Vitamin C
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of connective tissue
    • Needed for the absorption of iron
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Vitamin D
    • Needed for the absorption and utilisation of calcium and phosphorus
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of bone
    • Recognised as helping reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis
  • Vitamin E
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Folate
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
    • Needed for cell and blood formation
    • Needed for the normal development of the fetal neural tube
  • Pantothenic acid
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day1 sachet per serving

Labelled standard

Niacin labelled (10mg / 2g), 80~150%
Biotin labelled (56μg / 2g), 80~180%
Vitamin A labelled (211.1μg / 2g), 80~150%
Vitamin B1 labelled (2mg / 2g), 80~180%
Vitamin B12 labelled (2.9μg / 2g), 80~180%
Vitamin B2 labelled (2mg / 2g), 80~180%
Vitamin B6 labelled (2mg / 2g), 80~150%
Vitamin C labelled (30mg / 2g), 80~150%
Vitamin D labelled (5μg / 2g), 80~180%
Vitamin E labelled (8mg / 2g), 80~150%
Folate labelled (126μg / 2g), 80~150%
Pantothenic acid labelled (5mg / 2g), 80~180%
Appearance 흰노랑색의 분말
Coliform Negative
Shelf life 제조일부터 24개월
Storage ① 제품은 직사광선을 피해 서늘한 곳에 보관 유통하십시오. ② 제품 개봉 후에는 흡습되지 않게 밀봉하여 보관하십시오.

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Niacin · Biotin · Vitamin A · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B12 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin C · Vitamin D · Vitamin E · Folate · Pantothenic acid together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Pregnant or breastfeeding women should consult a professional before use · Allergic reactions may occur in sensitive individuals · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product

5) 비타민B12 : 표시량(9.6 ug / 500 mg)의 80~180%
6) 판토텐산 : 표시량(10 mg / 500 mg)의 80~180%
7) 비타민A : 표시량(700 ug RAE / 500 mg)의 80~150%
8) 비타민D : 표시량(10 ug / 500 mg)의 80~180%
9) 비타민B1 : 표시량(3 mg / 500 mg)의 80~180%
10) 비타민B2 : 표시량(3.5 mg / 500 mg)의 80~180%
11) 비타민B6 : 표시량(1.5 mg / 500 mg)의 80~150%

source.caution:

2. 신장질환이 있는 경우 섭취 전 전문가와 상담할 것
3. 이상사례 발생 시 섭취를 중단하고 전문가와 상담할 것
4. 고칼슘혈증이 있거나 의약품 복용 시 전문가와 상담할 것
5. 손발 따끔거림, 작열감 또는 저림 등의 이상사례 발생 시 섭취를 중단하고 전문가와 상담할 것

This product combines 22.5mg of Niacin, 90μg of Biotin, 700μg of Vitamin A, 3mg of Vitamin B1, 9.6μg of Vitamin B12, 3.5mg of Vitamin B2, 1.5mg of Vitamin B6, 50mg of Vitamin C, 10μg of Vitamin D, 5mg of Vitamin E, 400μg of Folate, 10mg of Pantothenic acid as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 tablet): 22.5mg Niacin, 90μg Biotin, 700μg Vitamin A, 3mg Vitamin B1, 9.6μg Vitamin B12, 3.5mg Vitamin B2, 1.5mg Vitamin B6, 50mg Vitamin C, 10μg Vitamin D, 5mg Vitamin E, 400μg Folate, 10mg Pantothenic acid
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 동서바이오팜(주) 안성공장

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Niacin
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Biotin
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production
  • Vitamin A
    • Needed for the adaptation of vision in dim light
    • Needed to form and maintain skin and mucous membranes
    • Needed for the growth and development of epithelial cells
  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B12
    • Needed for normal folate metabolism
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Vitamin C
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of connective tissue
    • Needed for the absorption of iron
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Vitamin D
    • Needed for the absorption and utilisation of calcium and phosphorus
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of bone
    • Recognised as helping reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis
  • Vitamin E
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Folate
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
    • Needed for cell and blood formation
    • Needed for the normal development of the fetal neural tube
  • Pantothenic acid
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production
